items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: Blackie Simmons saw Duke Ellington's bus pass by one time. They said, Duke Ellington's famous bus. Famous, Duke Ellington's famous orchestra.

ctx.x: Uh, can you carry your life forward a little bit from, as you were going to school at this time?

Um, and... Yes, I joined the, uh, little hillbilly band, Blackie Simmons. And Blackie Simmons saw Duke Ellington's bus pass by one time. They said, Duke Ellington's famous bus. Famous, Duke Ellington's famous orchestra. That's a famous orchestra all outside of the bus. And he had had Blackie's blue jackets, which was, uh, perfectly, uh, illiterative, you see, and, uh, proper title. And then he put Blackie's famous blue jackets, in imitation of Duke Ellington's famous orchestra, on the back of the bus. Blackie…

I went on to school for a half a year, joined them again in the summer, and came back to school for a half a year, then joined the La Crosse Doe Boys, which was a much better style band playing the same tunes with the same instrumentation.
